section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section provides the heading and date for the maamar delivered on Motzaei Shabbos Parshas Mikeitz, Shabbos Chanukah, 5738.
section.t: With the help of Heaven.
Motzaei Shabbos Parshas Mikeitz,
Shabbos Chanukah,

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section introduces the dispute between Beis Shammai and Beis Hillel regarding the order of lighting Chanukah candles, questions the connection to the Sukkos bull-offerings, and raises difficulties about the eight days, the number of lights, and the time of lighting.
section.t: The Sages taught: The mitzvah of the Chanukah light... Beis Shammai says: On the first day one lights eight, from there onward decreasing; and Beis Hillel says: On the first day one lights one, from there onward increasing.
The reason of Beis Shammai is corresponding to the bull-offerings of the festival [of Sukkos], and the reason of Beis Hillel is that we ascend in holiness...1.
And known is the precise question of the Alter Rebbe2,
What is the connection of the Chanukah light to the bull-offerings of the festival?
And especially according to what the Tzemach Tzedek wrote3,
That even Beis Hillel only disagree because of "we ascend in holiness."
And what is explained in many places4
That the connection of Chanukah to Sukkos is that both are eight days,
For the number eight indicates a level that is above the chain of descent5,
This itself requires explanation,
What is the connection of Sukkos and Chanukah to the level that is above the chain of descent,
Because of which they are eight days.
And also,
Since the institution of the Chanukah lights was because of the miracle that occurred with the lights of the Sanctuary,
And since in the Sanctuary there were seven lights,
Why are there eight lights in Chanukah
(and days)6.
And also one must understand that which the comparison
(the parallel)
of the Chanukah lights is
(not to the festival of Sukkos in general,
but rather)
specifically to the bull-offerings of the festival,
For ostensibly,
the Chanukah lights are related to the Menorah
(the Chanukah lights are because of the miracle that occurred with the lights of the Menorah),
and the bull-offerings of the festival were offered
(like all sacrifices)
upon the Altar,
and the Menorah and the Altar are two different vessels7
[And especially according to what is explained in Kabbalah and Chassidus8],
and lights and sacrifices are different services,
To the extent that "yours
(the lights)
is greater than theirs
(the sacrifices)
... they are never nullified"9.
And also one must understand that which its mitzvah
(of the Chanukah light)
is from sunset1,
For the precise point regarding this is known10,
That the lights of the Sanctuary were lit from plag haminchah,
an hour and a quarter before sunset11,
And since the Chanukah lights are
(as above)
because of the miracle that occurred with the lights of the Sanctuary
[And especially since whatever the Sages instituted, they instituted in the manner of Torah law12],
It would seemingly be fitting that the time of their lighting be like the lights of the Sanctuary,
And why is its mitzvah specifically from sunset.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the essence of the Chanukah lights is to illuminate the darkness, which is why they are lit specifically at sunset and are eight in number, representing a level above the chain of descent.
section.t: B)
And the point of the explanation regarding this13,
Is that the essence of the Chanukah lights is to illuminate the darkness.
For, behold, the miracle of Chanukah occurred after the Greeks entered the Sanctuary and defiled all the oils that were in the Sanctuary1,
That the strengthening of the darkness
(of the Greeks)14
was to such an extent,
That not only did they enter the Sanctuary and defile it,
But they also defiled all the oils that were in the Sanctuary.
For oil is a level of holiness
(as it is written15
"oil of sacred anointment")16,
"Holy" is a term in and of itself17
(similar to oil that floats18
on top of all other liquids and does not mix with them)19.
From this it is understood,
That this defiling of all the oils in the Sanctuary
touches upon
(in particular this)
even more than their defiling of the Sanctuary,
Even though the holiness of the Sanctuary is an exalted level among the ten levels of holiness20.
And as is also proven from the fact that even after "Your children came... and purified Your Sanctuary"21,
Behold, in order to be able to light the Menorah they specifically needed a miracle,
Beginning from the miracle22
That they found one cruse of pure oil sealed with the seal of the Kohen Gadol23,
The light of Ein Sof that is above the chain of descent,
Regarding which light even24
"darkness does not darken,"
And on the contrary, this light illuminates the darkness so that even the darkness will shine,
And "it will be"25
(with the addition of a Vav)
"my darkness will shine"26.
And this is that the mitzvah of the Chanukah light is specifically from sunset,
Because the essence of the Chanukah lights is to illuminate the darkness.
And this is also that the Chanukah lights are specifically eight
(and likewise the days of Chanukah are eight27),
For the number eight indicates
(as above in section 1)
a level that is above the chain of descent,
For it is specifically by means of this level that it is possible to illuminate even the darkness28.
